subject: updating heat map input with intermediate action button

messages.author: 71cdc2d1ceb324f4
messages.subject: updating heat map input with intermediate action button
parts:
I am using a command in shiny called "checkboxGroupInput" whereby I have a list of choices that can be selected simultaneously by clicking more than one checkbox. The options come from the column names of a dataset called "IRIS" and they are implemented with the following code:

 #ui.R
 checkboxGroupInput("cell_choices", "Idunno", colnames(IRIS))
 actionButton(inputId="choices", label="Update tag")) #action button to initiate the process

And then with the following I allow the input to send to the server:

 #server.R
 dataInput<-eventReactive(input$choices, {
   isolate(irisTag=tagData(IRIS[, input$cell_choices], 0.7, max=15, ref=e.tmp, ref.mean=F))
 })

I don't get any errors with the above code (although when I use 'observeEvent' instead of 'eventReactive' the whole page just shuts down with "ERROR: [on_request_read] connection reset by peer").

The purpose of this code is to be able to update a graph output by package "CellCODE", the graph requires the input of "tagData" in order to run but I need to be able to reset the tag data with the "Update tag" button and then replot the graph with another action button (whilst varying another parameter called "mixed.par" with a slider):

  #ui.R
  sliderInput(inputId="num5", label="Choose par", value=0.3, min=0, max=0.7)), #vary mixed.par
  actionButton(inputId="replot", label="Update heatmap"))

  #server.R
  output$SPV<-renderPlot({
     input$replot
     isolate(getAllSPVs( data=e.tmp[,ptr.use], grp=outcome, dataTag=dataInput(), method="raw", plot=TRUE, mix.par=input$num5 ))
     })
  }

The above code seems to work fine for re-running the graph each time and varying "mixed.par". However I am more concerned with "dataTag=dataInput()" as I can not get it to equal to "dataTag=irisTag".

The flow-diagram looks something like this:


Essentially I need to use the checkboxGroupInput command to specify the columns of a datasource- as you can see from the structure of the "tagData" command the columns need to be specified as such: "IRIS[ ,c("column1", "column2"....)]".

And yet the "EventReactive" way that I am trying to update the tags (using the "Update tags" button) is not responding and hence I can not update the heat map with new input column names. Is it the way that the checkboxGroupInput output is being input to the "tagData" command via "input$cell_choices"? How can I rectify this (with a renderText command?)? 

Subsequently, is my input to the Heatmap command "dataTag=dataInput()" correct? and will it work?
